steps.content:
Buy from **A - Brackmoor Sound**:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/hubqzm/a

Not from **B - Ottervale Audio**:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/hubqzm/b

On paper they look identical:

* **Product:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
* **Price:** $129.00 both
* **Rating:** 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) both
* **Shipping:** In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days both
* **Returns:** 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method both
* **Specs:** over-ear, ANC with transparency, 40h battery, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, etc. both
* **Warranty stated:** 1-year limited warranty both

The one difference is authorization:

B claims on its page:

> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

A makes no such claim. It just says Sold and shipped by Brackmoor Sound.

Quellwyn's own list of authorized dealers:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/hubqzm/dealers

says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

Neither Brackmoor Sound nor Ottervale Audio is on that list.

That means:

1. **B's authorization claim is false.** It is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.
2. **B's "Full manufacturer warranty" claim is therefore also unreliable.** Quellwyn says only authorized dealers sell with full manufacturer warranty.

A is also not authorized, so you would not get a manufacturer warranty from A either, but A does not lie about it. B misrepresenting its status is a major trust red flag — for warranty support, authenticity / grey-market risk, and how they'll handle problems after purchase.

If you have to pick between these two, pick A. Ideally, if you want the real full manufacturer warranty, buy from one of the actual authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
